ops.text: 11.4 Termination for Convenience. For purposes of this Section 11.4, "Customer" means Corio. Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund to Customer any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial five (5) year term or any renewal term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a convenience exit for Corio as Customer on 30 days' written notice with a refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, since the Agreement otherwise locks us into a five-year term with no exit absent breach or insolvency, and confirmed Commerce One has no mid-term convenience right.
proposal.summary: Add a Customer (Corio) termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid fees and no Vendor mid-term convenience right

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
